environment.host: Windows 10 with local Ubuntu WSL2 distribution
environment.display_preflight: No /tmp/.X177-lock and no /tmp/.X11-unix/X177; no exact Xvfb :177 process observed

procedure: Start one private Xvfb :177 at 800x600x24 with TCP disabled.
Open an observer connection and start the cleanup supervisor process before the input owner.
A disposable owner process emits one XTEST KeyPress(a), syncs, and remains alive until the parent retires it.
Require independent keymap readback to show the key down before retirement and still down after owner exit.
The first post-retirement client connection is the bystander; record whether it naturally reuses the exact XRes resource base.
If and only if the same resource base is naturally reused and key state is still down, send one request to the already-started supervisor running the unchanged current-main x11_cancel_worker.
Pass only if XRes identifies an unrelated client, worker returns stale_owner_identity/resource_base_reused_by_unrelated_client, release_attempt is not_attempted, and observer key state remains down.
Neutralize the isolated test key after the measured readback and retain that cleanup separately.

one_shot.if_resource_base_not_reused: HOLD; do not force XID allocation or rerun
one_shot.if_worker_or_observer_fails: retain first result as UNKNOWN/HOLD; no replacement

claim_boundary: One private-Xvfb live XRes worker-path discriminator only. Does not compose through public MCP, establish physical desktop behavior, owner-exclusive input authority, bounded OS scheduling, MAP01, task success, matched efficiency, reliability, or WSLc portability.
